Business and Leadership offers MBA, MA in Leadership, a leadership certificate and their dual degree; no business doctorate. Current doctoral programmes are Nursing Practice, Clinical Psychology and Medical Science, all in health fields.

The complete current graduate programme inventory has Business and Leadership, Education, Fine Arts and Health categories, with no engineering or mathematical research doctorate. No Operations doctorate is inferred from unrelated professional health qualifications.
